messages:
Hannah Li: Heads-up — Celestia Labs (acct CL-902) invoice INV-2026-401 for $14,220 is overdue. AP emailed asking to split and disputing $720 for suspected duplicate job runs. @Maya - CS can you confirm contact?
Maya - CS: On it. Finance lead called. They say a partner retry caused duplicated job IDs. Ticket TKT-5622 with logs attached. They asked for 30/35/35 and the $720 credit.
Omar Farouk: Policy check: managers can approve credits up to $1,000 and payment plans up to 90 days with initial >=30%. So both items are within ops authority if we get docs and a signed agreement.
Zoe Park: If engineering confirms duplicate ingestion, approve the $720 one-time goodwill. Require signed payment agreement and initial 30% cleared before lifting any suspension. Also redact internal job IDs on the invoice per customer request.
Riley (Billing): Proposed terms:
```
- One-time credit: $720 (contingent on signed agreement)
- Adjusted balance: $13,500
- Schedule: 30% ($4,050) due 2025-12-07, 35% ($4,725) due 2026-01-06, 35% ($4,725) due 2026-02-05
- Waive current late fee if initial payment clears by 2025-12-10
```
Sending INV-2026-401-A via DocuSign. Pausing auto-suspend 72h while customer signs.
collections-bot: Dunning notice sent at 2005000600. Suspension timer paused per manual override.
Maya - CS: Customer viewed DocuSign and asked to anonymize job ids on the invoice lines. Riley, can you sanitize?
Riley (Billing): Done. DocuSign sent at 2005000900 -> viewed at 2005001200. Reminder scheduled: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-08.
Hannah Li: Engineering please confirm duplicate claim. If eng validates, finalize credit. If not, we hold credit and still offer standard payment plan.
Zoe Park: Eng confirms ingest retry due to missing request-id on one retry (ENG-3320). Recommend credit.
Maya - CS: Customer verbally accepted terms and will sign and wire the initial 30% by 2025-12-07. They sent wire reference in the ticket.
Riley (Billing): Noted. I'll post receipt when funds arrive and update ledger. If initial payment doesn't clear by 2025-12-10, resume suspension and escalate.
collections-bot: Reminder scheduled: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-10.
Hannah Li: Summary: approve $720 credit (one-time), 30/35/35 payment plan, hold suspension until 2026-01-05 contingent on initial 30% cleared and signed agreement. Escalate if payment fails. Thanks team :thumbsup:
